definitions.explanation: A state of physical or mental comfort and freedom from pain or hardship. Often used in formal or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {安楽|あんらく}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安楽|あんらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live comfortably in my old age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧きた⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{安楽|あんらく}な⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごしている→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather, who worked for many years, now spends peaceful days in the countryside.

notes: Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{安楽死|あんらくし}→安楽死：18174_anrakushi⟧ (euthanasia, literally 'peaceful death'). Other compounds: {安楽椅子|あんらくいす} (easy chair, armchair). As a standalone adjective, {安楽|あんらく}な has a somewhat formal or literary tone; in everyday speech, ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ or ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧ are more common for describing comfort. Related: ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ (easy, comfortable — more casual), ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧ (comfortable — modern, everyday).
